clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
under the Emergency Relief Appropria­
tion Act of 1935 (49 Stat. 115, 118), and 
the act entitled “An Act to provide that 
funds allocated to Puerto Rico under the 
Emergency Relief Appropriation Act of 
1935 may be expended for permanent re­
habilitation, and for other purposes”, 
approved February 11, 1936 (49 Stat. 
1135), I  hereby appoint James P. Davis, 
Director, Division of Territories and Is­
land Possessions, Department of the In­
terior, as Administrator of the Puerto 
Rico Reconstruction Administration, 
vice Edwin G. Arnold, resigned, to serve 
without additional compensation, and to 
exercise and discharge the functions, 
duties, and authority conferred upon the 
Puerto Rico Reconstruction jAdministra- 
tion and the Administrator by Executive 
Orders No. 7057 of May 28, 1935, No. 
7180 of September 6,1935, as amended by 
No. 7554 of February 17, 1937, and No. 
7689 of August 12, 1937.
The said Executive orders are hereby 
amended accordingly.
